thesis: The speaker describes growing up in an environment of constant financial boom and bust cycles caused by his father's highly levered, zero-capital businesses that repeatedly failed every three to four years. He explains that he received an accidental education in business by serving on his father's board of directors and making sales calls during these crises, arguing that necessity is the mother of invention and that one learns business best when facing adversity.
